caption: The drawing depicts two objects centered within a rectangular outlined area on an otherwise blank, tan-colored background. On the left side of the rectangle is a square or rectangular brooch or box with a multi-layered border; the outermost border is black, followed by a thin yellow or gold border, then a white or light-colored layer, and finally an inner rectangular section with a patterned or textured gray-and-brown surface. To the right of this object, there is a depiction of the same item in profile, showing its depth and construction, with a yellow or gold tone and a small loop or mechanism on the side. At the bottom left outside of the rectangle, the text "Westchester County" is written, and at the bottom right it says "Drawn by Wm P. Shearwood." The background is plain with no additional decorative elements.
title: Brooch
